representation.recommended_class_candidate: ensemble components=[exact protected class control.components[0], exact preregistered METH01 ExtraTrees class recipe], weights=[0.9,0.1]
representation.extra_trees: 128 trees, depth16, min_samples_leaf4, max_features0.9, seed42, generic_features=none, inherited class_weight_power0.5
representation.valid_existing_worker: worker.py49-65 accepts two or three positive-weight non-ensemble component recipes. The first lightgbm component may retain categorical_te_pair; worker.py113-124 expands that feature view internally. Result iteration tree is [[view0,view1],ET], supported by existing recursive R4 checks and full-refit dispatch.
representation.forbidden_expansion: Explicit nested ensemble is rejected. Adding ET to the entire existing three-component V16 class ensemble, or replacing its first component by an explicit nested blend, cannot preserve exact behavior within the current two/three-component non-nested limit. Flattening the latter needs four top-level components. Do not change this engine contract.
representation.flattening_unnecessary: The two-component [feature-view SINGLE,ET] representation already preserves the original view recipe and fitting scope; deriving and freezing feature-view children separately adds avoidable equivalence risk.

minimal_procedure.preserve: Keep the full historical V16 class ensemble as protected complete control, its first SINGLE as HPO anchor, separate broad/selector candidate and CatBoost/XGBoost family coverage.
minimal_procedure.new_opt_in: The existing --champion-recipe loader rejects components/weights and ensemble at stages.py69-99. Add only a narrowly validated fixed class-blend seed input after the five mandatory seeds; retain default-OFF behavior and the existing worker. Do not generalize planner ensemble syntax or enable arbitrary nesting/weight search.
minimal_procedure.slot_effect: With maximum9 outer experiments and maximum7 initial slots, the new class seed consumes one optional initial Qwen slot, leaving at most one initial proposal and reserving two HPO/followup slots. This compares complete seeded search procedures, not a pure learner effect.
minimal_procedure.hpo: Preserved mode runner.py364-371 selects the original successful SINGLE anchor by signature and allows only lightgbm/catboost/xgboost. The ensemble seed and ExtraTrees must not become HPO anchors.
minimal_procedure.automatic_blending: runner.py436 excludes ensemble candidates from its ordinary cached pair/triple weight search. The new two-component recipe therefore retains its fixed0.9/0.1 weights; do not add a new blend sweep.
minimal_procedure.both_task_AB: Both arms retain the identical CP1 strong regression seed/source policy. Class A retains the current complete procedure; class B adds only the fixed seed as above. Match task order, per-task solver/worker/API/HPO caps, immutable inputs and splits. Require actual selected primary/confirmation evidence, fresh full-data refit, submission CSV/probability/ID integrity, source and terminal ownership proof under R4. Candidate measurement alone does not qualify the selected agent.
minimal_procedure.quality: Declare class per-cut all-class/support/ex-rarest gates and comparison with the retained V16 complete control before execution. Do not infer superiority over V16 from the prior component-versus-SINGLE result. Preserve failed or missing task/cut evidence as null and all historical controls.

cost.scope: Future training/refitting, not the prior720-second saved-prediction evaluation.
cost.student_leaves: The candidate has three student leaves per worker evaluation: two existing feature-view learners plus ET. This is not a total fitting-call count because nested stopping/calibration can perform additional fits.
cost.outer_formula: A genuine both-task A/B requires 2*T_regression+2*T_classification+setup+independent_audit+cleanup with equal arm caps and explicit reserves for confirmation/refit/CSV. Existing CP1 allocates2100 per regression task (2010 solver); this does not establish an adequate classification cap. New classification runtime is not measured, so no fixed whole-campaign duration is certified here.
